content:
alex: FYI we're seeing a surge of 429s hitting the eu-west GPU fleet starting ~11:12 UTC. Errors are concentrated on medium/long generation routes, p99 latency drifting up.

sre-bot: [ALERT] region=eu-west-1 pool=gpu-standard queue_depth=74 ingress=95r/s cpu=78% gpu_mem=84%

maria: From the logs it's clear the admission controller is rejecting at the front door (server-side backpressure), not a downstream network drop. Rejections include no extra context right now which makes SDK handling awkward.

kevin: Rightwe currently return plain 429 with a generic body. Clients see identical 429s for quota vs server protection.

jamie: We need richer signals so SDKs can avoid blind retries and cascading stampedes. Proposal for response headers (minimal):
- X-RW-Admission: queued|rejected
- X-RW-Queue-Depth: <int>
- X-RW-Estimate-wait-ms: <int>
- X-RW-Reason: regional_saturation|client_quota
- Retry-After or X-RW-Retry-ms

elaine: Also include X-RW-Admission-Hint: warm|cold. warm means we expect a slot to free within the estimate, cold means the queue growth is sustained.

alex: Example we can start returning (ops can roll canary in eu-west first):

```http
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
X-RW-Admission: queued
X-RW-Queue-Depth: 78
X-RW-Estimate-wait-ms: 4300
X-RW-Admission-Hint: warm
X-RW-Region: eu-west-1
Retry-After: 4

{ "error": "admission_throttled" }
```

kevin: Semantic distinction is crucial: 429 due to client quota (exhausted tokens) should carry X-RW-Reason: client_quota and SDKs should short-circuit with a quota error UI. 429 from admission should be treated as transient.

jamie: SDK behavior suggestions:
1) If X-RW-Reason=client_quota -> surface to caller immediately.
2) If X-RW-Admission=queued and estimate <= 5000ms -> honor server estimate (sleep estimate + small jitter) then retry once.
3) If estimate > 5000ms -> consult policy: either fallback to cheaper model, route to fallback region, or fail fast depending on allowAutomaticFailover flag.
4) Always add random jitter (~0-20% of delay, capped) to avoid synchronized retries.

kevin: Example JS snippet for SDK retry logic:

```js
const est = parseInt(headers.get('x-rw-estimate-wait-ms') || '0', 10);
const reason = headers.get('x-rw-reason');
if (reason === 'client_quota') throw new Error('quota_exceeded');
if (est > 0) {
  const jitter = Math.random() * Math.min(1000, est * 0.2);
  await sleep(Math.min(est, 30000) + jitter);
  // optionally check headers.get('x-rw-fallback-model')
}
```

maria: Admission controller will compute estimate from EWMA of service time and current queue depth. We'll also emit a token id (X-RW-Admission-Token) when we actually enqueue a request so clients can reattach if they retry.

elaine: Ops note: we'll gate the header rollout behind a feature flag. Canaries go to eu-west-1 non-prod first, then prod with a small percentage. Also plan to expose metrics for queue depth and admission-reject-rate in Console.

alex: Two policy items to decide:
- Should SDKs auto-failover across regions by default? (data residency/security implications) My recommendation: off by default, opt-in via allowAutomaticRegionFailover = false.
- Backoff strategy: server estimate preferred; otherwise default to capped exponential (base 1.6, cap 30s) with jitter.

jamie: We'll implement defaults as you suggested and expose hooks for teams to override. Also add a flag allowFallbackModel (default true) so mobile/edge callers can opt into cheaper fallbacks rather than waiting.

kevin: We'll add X-RW-Fallback-Model header when server can suggest a compatible cheaper model (e.g., redwood/mini-3-quant). SDKs can choose to route to that.

maria: Action items:
- runtime: add headers X-RW-Admission, X-RW-Queue-Depth, X-RW-Estimate-wait-ms, X-RW-Admission-Hint, X-RW-Admission-Token, X-RW-Reason, X-RW-Fallback-Model (owner: maria)
- SDK: parse new headers, default to capped-exp backoff w/ server estimate preference, expose failover config (owner: jamie)
- ops: deploy header feature flag in eu-west canary and add console charts for admission metrics (owner: elaine)

kevin: I'll also update our docs with recommended SDK patterns and include sample snippets. Will link the doc here after draft.

jamie: I'll open the SDK PR and mark region failover opt-in.

alex: For immediate relief I'm opening a temporary burst pool in eu-west and redirecting non-sensitive low-priority traffic to dedicated fleet. Keep monitoring.

sre-bot: [RESOLVED] auto-ack at 11:27 UTC.

maria: I'll land the PR behind feature flag and ping SDK once the canary is up.

jamie: PR queued, ETA noon UTC for first review. :thumbsup:
